scenes.title: SCENE 1. A rain-soaked street at night.
scenes.body:
Rain falls. LIN stands under an awning, watching a doorway. ASH steps out of the shadows.
LIN: You're late. Did anyone follow you?
ASH: No. The rain covers everything.
LIN: Then talk. What did you find in the office?
ASH: The files were moved. Someone cleaned the room before dawn.
